_note: Enhancements and Upgrades, keyed by id. See NEW_ARMY_BUILD_GUIDE.md §5.3. Enhancements go on non-Epic-Hero CHARACTER models only; that gate is applied by the app on top of each entry's own restriction.

follow-me-ladz.name: Follow Me Ladz
follow-me-ladz.short: +2" Move for the unit it leads.
follow-me-ladz.description: ORKS model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, add 2" to the Move characteristic of models in that unit.

headwoppas-killchoppa.name: Headwoppa’s Killchoppa
headwoppas-killchoppa.description: ORKS model only. Melee weapons equipped by the bearer (excluding Extra Attacks weapons) have the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability.

kunnin-but-brutal.name: Kunnin’ But Brutal
kunnin-but-brutal.short: Led unit can shoot and charge after Falling Back.
kunnin-but-brutal.description: ORKS model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, that unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

supa-cybork-body.name: Supa-Cybork Body
supa-cybork-body.description: ORKS model only. The bearer has the Feel No Pain 4+ ability.

_da_big_hunt_note: Da Big Hunt enhancements. Their restrictions key off BEAST SNAGGA and BEASTBOSS ON SQUIGOSAUR; no datasheet in data/units/ carries either keyword yet, so these stay unselectable until those units are added. That is expected, not a bug.

glory-hog.name: Glory Hog
glory-hog.description: BEASTBOSS ON SQUIGOSAUR model only. Models in the bearer’s unit have the Scouts 9" ability.

proper-killy.name: Proper Killy
proper-killy.short: +1 Damage on the bearer’s melee weapons.
proper-killy.description: BEAST SNAGGA model only. Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of melee weapons equipped by the bearer.

skrag-every-stash.name: Skrag Every Stash!
skrag-every-stash.short: Hold an objective the bearer reached without leaving models on it.
skrag-every-stash.description: BEAST SNAGGA model only. At the end of your Command phase, if the bearer is within range of an objective marker you control, that objective marker remains under your control, even if you have no models within range of it, until your opponent controls it at the start or end of any turn.

surly-as-a-squiggoth.name: Surly as a Squiggoth
surly-as-a-squiggoth.short: −1 to Wound against the led unit when S beats T.
surly-as-a-squiggoth.description: BEASTBOSS ON SQUIGOSAUR model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, each time an attack targets that unit, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than the Toughness characteristic of that unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.
